new: The obverse shows the coat of arms of The Bahamas, with a marlin and a flamingo holding a shield, and the words Commonwealth of The Bahamas with the date below. The reverse shows three starfish with the words 1 Cent.

The obverse shows Queen Elizabeth the Second wearing a tiara and facing right, with the words Elizabeth II Bermuda. The reverse shows a Bermuda lily flower, with the date above it and the words Ten Cents below.
The obverse shows a thick cross with the date below and the word Oesterreich above. The reverse shows a large numeral 2 with the word Groschen.

The obverse shows the Mexican coat of arms, a golden eagle perched on a prickly pear cactus and holding a snake in its beak, with the words Estados Unidos Mexicanos. The reverse shows stylized rays from the Aztec sun stone around the denomination and mint mark.
source: hobbyofkings.eu (Mexico 10 Centavos KM#432 design reference); Etsy KM#934 listing (Aztec solar rays reverse, 2009-2019 stainless type)
